verdict.rationale: Blink provides a shell with standard Unix file commands (cp, rm, mv, mkdir, grep, etc.) and scp/sftp/curl. These conventionally allow multi-item operations through typed commands, but the evidence never documents any bulk-operation feature or AI-oriented batch tooling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/multi-item operations (globbing, batch file actions in Blink Files, multi-host command execution), any AI-native or programmatic batch interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
